command:
export DISPLAY=:98 WINEPREFIX=/home/runner/.wine_mt5 WINEARCH=win64 WINEDEBUG=-all
rm -f /tmp/.X98-lock
pgrep -f "Xvfb :98" || Xvfb :98 -screen 0 1280x800x24 -ac &
sleep 2
# Init MT5 wine prefix
[ -d "$WINEPREFIX" ] || (wineboot --init 2>&1 | tail -2)
# MT5 install
echo "=== MT5 install starting ==="
wine /tmp/mt5setup.exe /auto 2>&1 | grep -vE "^$|fixme|err|warn" | tail -20
echo "=== MT5 install done ==="
ls "$WINEPREFIX/drive_c/Program Files/MetaTrader 5/" 2>&1 | head -3
